desc:
A classic difficulty chart obby with a smooth progression from Effortless all the way up to Nil. The game features 300+ stages with steadily increasing difficulty, designed to test consistency, precision, and overall skill. Early stages are accessible for beginners, while later stages become significantly more challenging.

DISLIKE = RAGE QUIT! 😈

Includes a clean layout, clear difficulty system, and balanced progression so you can track your improvement as you climb.

Play at your own pace and see how far you can get.

Tags: obby, difficulty chart, dco, parkour, skill, stages, progression, challenging, hard, extreme, tower, skill-based, practice
